agreement.note: How the measured value compares with the datasheet or a second check.

ci95.note: 95% confidence interval as [low, high], 4 significant digits.

datasheet.note: The vendor datasheet's number or band for this term.

in_twin.note: Whether the deployed twin uses this term.

method.note: How the term was obtained, cut at 240 characters.

note.note: The card's note, cut at 240 characters (…).

status.note: measured | board (read from the moteus config) | datasheet | refused (fit rejected as ill-posed) | pending (not measured yet).

value.note: The card's value. Drawn measured (fitted from real recordings), chosen (a board setting), datasheet, or estimate for a refused fit that the twin does not use. Not a single number or pending: shown as — with the reason; the raw value is in value_text.

value_text.note: The card's value as JSON text (composite values: lists, dicts, strings), cut at 120 characters.
